description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractAuditableCustom that extends persistence capabilities for auditable entities within the Apache Fineract project. It customizes audit-related fields such as createdBy, createdDate, lastModifiedBy, and lastModifiedDate, overriding default behaviors from Spring Data's AbstractAuditable.

classes.name: AbstractAuditableCustom
classes.description: An abstract base class for entities that require auditing features, storing created and last modified metadata with customized column names and using LocalDateTime for timestamp fields.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the identifier of the user who created the entity.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the user who created the entity.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the timestamp when the entity was created.

methods.name: getLastModifiedBy
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the identifier of the user who last modified the entity.

methods.name: setLastModifiedBy
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the user who last modified the entity.

methods.name: getLastModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns an Optional with the timestamp of last modification.
